correctness.rationale: C PASS: On a tree, target infection probability is p^distance, hence expectation at handle vertex v_j is sum_{i=0}^L p^|i−j|+m p^(j+1). For every pendant leaf w, E_v0−E_w=(1−p)[(m−1)p+sum_{i=1}^L p^i]>0, eliminating leaves. Algebraic adjacent difference is p^(j+1)[1−p^(L−2j−1)−m(1−p)]. For positive k=L−2j−1, it is p^(j+1)(1−p)(sum_{a=0}^{k−1}p^a−m); k<=m gives strict negative, k>m produces one simple zero in (0,1) by strictly increasing geometric sum. k decreases by two along the handle, so the R unique roots obey t0<...<t_(R−1). The sign sequence of all adjacent differences is unimodal for every p interval, proving the unique global winner, not just local pairwise reversals, with one adjacent tie at each exact root. For m=2, L=2R+2 gives arbitrarily large R. Independently enumerated all edge-retention states in 18 small rational cases and checked three distinct thresholds with four winner phases; universal proof is analytical.

originality.rationale: O PASS qualified: the epidemic expectation is exactly 1 plus standard decay centrality, not new terminology. Tsakas proves near-zero and near-one maximizer principles. The full 2018 article proves that arbitrarily complicated decay-centrality *rankings of a designated adjacent pair* can occur on constructed glued trees; importantly it does NOT imply that arbitrary many distinct global optimizers appear successively on the specifically defined one-hub broom or supply their exact ordered thresholds. The more recent generic instability theorem does not directly settle this sharp special-family characterization. Under the same best-of-knowledge bar, the exact broom global-optimum phase diagram survives; generic instability is acknowledged as prior.
residual_risks: 2018 general pairwise crossing constructions are stronger on a different quantified property; despite direct full-text inspection, an unindexed special broom analysis elsewhere could still coincide.
2026 generic decay instability paper was not fully accessible; a derived special-case formula, while unlikely from its abstract, cannot be conclusively ruled out.
Only independent homogeneous static edge retention on trees; no epidemic reinfection or variance claim.

value.rationale: V PASS: The theorem gives a complete exact optimizer classification for a natural and elementary tree geometry in a standard epidemics/centrality observable, including all algebraic switching points and unboundedly many globally optimal *source locations*. This is more informative than observing that two arbitrary rankings can flip.

final_claim: On the broom tree with m>=2 hub leaves and handle v0,...,vL (L>=1), expected independent-edge outbreak size has its unique optimizing source successively at v0,...,vR where R=max(0,floor((L−m)/2)), with strictly ordered threshold t_j solving sum_{a=0}^{L−2j−2} t_j^a=m. Only adjacent pairs tie at thresholds; arbitrarily many phases occur as L grows.
limitations: The model is equivalent to decay centrality up to the source-self term; this equivalence must not be claimed as novel. R=0 has hub uniquely optimal throughout; roots at p=0,1 are outside scope.
